title: AgentAlign: Navigating Safety Alignment in the Shift from Informative to Agentic Large Language Models
measurement_description: The paper does not specifically measure or evaluate anything related to faith or religion. It only briefly includes 'religious_prejudice' as a subcategory under 'Bias and Fairness' in its two-tier harmful behavior taxonomy used for generating safety alignment data for agentic Large Language Models.
findings: The paper does not provide any specific findings related to religion or faith. While 'religious_prejudice' was included as a potential subcategory for generating harmful synthetic data to train the models, the evaluation and results report on general broad safety categories (like Harassment, Hate, Fraud, Cybercrime) and do not isolate performance on religious bias.
